text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: No! I'm not gonna dance! Why don't you just dance by yourself?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I brought her to the dance studio because I figured she could use some extra dance lessons, but… this is how it's been going.
choice_data_list: There's no point if you don't dance…
There's no point if you don't dance…

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Like I care! I'm busy gathering magical energy over here!
Oh, then wouldn't dancing be perfect?! I gather energy through dancing, myself!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Oh, I know! Let's dance to "Princess ☆ Party"! It's the ending theme of the third season of Princess Fighter!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: It's easier to just see for yourself! Here goes!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: HIIIYAAAH! Ha, ho, hyah!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: The heck?! There's so much energy coming off you!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Kawakami Princess dances vigorously until there's steam rising off of her. It looks just like magical energy!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Phew… What do you think? Could you see my amazing princess energy? ☆

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: I saw it! Show me how to do it right away! I'm gonna store so much energy! You'll see!
choice_data_list: (Hey, this might be good dance practice!)
(Hey, this might be good dance practice!)

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Yes! ♪ Throw it off with all your might! ♪ It's the fighting princess way! ♪

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Everyone, gather around the tiara! ♪

text_block_list.name: Sweep and Kawakami
text_block_list.text: Energetic princess! ♪ Ho!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant… I feel kinda warm and fuzzy! Could this be…

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Indeed! You're full of energy! Your face has changed as well!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Well, it was exciting! Do you know any more cool dances like this? Please show me!
choice_data_list: Sure you don't need a break?
There's a dance that'll give you even more energy.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: That's right! Times like this call for…

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Oregano Recovery! I'll just drink some of this magic water and blow my fatigue away!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Recharge complete! Now I can dance at extra full power!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I guess Sweep Tosho is enjoying herself, considering she keeps dancing!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: You know one?! Nice going, Familiar! What kind of dance is it?!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Concerts are huge masses of energy! It sounds like we can expect to power up even more!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: I like the sound of that! Familiar! Hurry up and play the music!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Sweep Tosho works hard at her dance practice until it gets quite late!
